title: Run your own tournament in Pro
summary: Create a single-elimination or round-robin bracket, share the link, and let players ready up and jump straight into their match. Results and replays land on the bracket as games finish.
body: Organizers can leave heroes and the map open or lock them per match. Your next match shows as a banner on the Pro page and in the account menu, so you never have to hunt for a room code.
Every finished match gets a public replay link, and organizers have tools to override a result, extend signup or cancel.
